observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with white and black keys, placed on an orange plastic chair.
The keyboard has a central control panel with a small LCD screen, buttons, and a dial.
The keys appear to be standard piano-style, with 61 keys visible in the photos.
The keyboard has a purple and teal color scheme on the control panel area.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is clearly visible on the top and bottom of the keyboard in all photos.
The keyboard is not shown powered on or playing; no sound is heard or demonstrated.
The photos are taken in a room with a concrete wall and tiled floor in the background.
Watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The brand 'Yamaha' is visible in all photos, but 'professional' is subjective and not verifiable from the images alone.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not be functional (e.g., keys not working, no sound, or internal damage)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys being pressed, and sound output.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, stand, or sustain pedal)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: Keyboard may be damaged or have wear not visible in photos (e.g., cracked keys, broken buttons, or internal damage)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all keys, buttons, and control panel from multiple angles, including under the keys.

proof_requests: Video clip showing the keyboard powered on and playing sound.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up photos of all keys, buttons, and control panel from multiple angles.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
